s.note: cooked in the coals on the high plains
s.how: Rub 60g butter into 450g self-raising flour and a pinch of salt. Mix in about 300ml milk with a knife, shape into a round and score the top. Bake at 200C for 30 minutes until it sounds hollow. Serve with butter and golden syrup.
Simmer a 1.2kg corned silverside with an onion, a carrot and peppercorns for 3 hours, then cool in the liquid. Slice thin onto 8 slices buttered white bread with English mustard and mustard pickles.

m.note: cooked over the fire on the high plains
m.how: Brown 1.2kg lamb shoulder chops in a heavy pot. Add 2 onions, 3 carrots, 600g potatoes and 750ml stock with rosemary. Cover and simmer over coals or at 160C for 2.5 hours. Finish with chopped parsley.

w.n: Colt from Old Regret spotted dog
w.note: the prize colt that got away to the brumbies
w.how: Rub 100g butter into 250g self-raising flour, stir in 75g sugar and 150g currants, then add 150ml milk to a soft dough. Wrap in a floured cloth or basin and steam for 2 hours. Serve with golden syrup and custard.

d.note: Clancy of the Overflow, boiled over the fire
d.how: Boil 1.2L water in a billy or pot. Throw in 3 tbsp loose leaf tea and a gum leaf if you have one, take it off the heat and swing it round to settle the leaves. Pour into tin mugs with milk and sugar.
